To compute a4, we first need to compute a3. So, we substitute n=1 into the recursive formula, as follows:

an+2=an+1+ana1+2=a1+1+a1a3=a2+a1a3=5+(−3)a3=2

Next, to compute a4, we substitute n=2 into the recursive formula: a2+2=a2+1+a2a4=a3+a2a4=2+5a4=7

Therefore, a4=7.

Substituting n=1 into the recursive formula gives: f(1+2)=f(1+1)+f(1)f(3)=f(2)+f(1)f(3)=7+2f(3)=9.

Hence, f(3)=9.
